title: Chapter 1146
text:
"Do it!"

A sudden change occurred on the stage. Following a loud shout, a commotion broke out on the spectator stands. About one-fifth of the players in the stadium suddenly rose into the air and pounced toward Han Xiao, who was on the main stage. The weapons in their hands shone brightly. They were all heroes who had answered the call and decided to sacrifice their lives for justice.

It was as if a string that had been stretched taut all this time had suddenly snapped. The rest of the players looked excited.

In the crowd, Winter Wolf's eyes sparkled, and he ordered in the channel.

"The chance is here! Let's go! "

The next moment, hundreds of players rose up and were about to attack the audience.

Winter Wolf soared into the air. Frost condensed on his body, leaving ice crystals all over the sky. He rushed straight toward the celebrity guest seats.

Winter Wolf's eyes reflected the shocked faces of many celebrities when they turned around. Excitement appeared on his face, and he raised his hand to release his Esper Ability without hesitation, preparing to turn these celebrities into ice sculptures.

At the same time, the heroes who were charging toward the main stage also noticed this group of people who were taking the opportunity to cause trouble. Many of them were shocked and angry.

There was no part of the plan that affected the audience. Subconsciously, some of them wanted to turn around and stop the guild spies led by Winter Wolf from killing the innocent.

All of these changes happened in a flash. Just as the chaos was about to erupt, bright lightning suddenly burst out from the center of the venue!

Kacha!

Countless Mechanical Force lightning bolts shot out like a spider web. The mechanical soldiers that had been lying in ambush in the audience seats were activated instantly and pounced toward the players who were causing trouble.

These ambushers were all 'Restrainer- Modified', which specialized in control. They could disintegrate into high-tech restraining suits and use their bodies to capture the target alive. With the bonus from Han Xiao's Mechanical Force, their attributes were far above the current Grade B players.

Sizzle —

Black shadows flashed in the venue, and the players who were charging toward Han Xiao were all like birds with broken wings. They were all restrained by the electromagnetic chains and force field restraining devices of the Restrainers, unable to move.

Flying Free and the other contestants on the main stage were immediately sent flying by the explosion of energy, crashing into the edge of the stage.

Just as they were about to get up and continue charging, Han Xiao gently flipped his palm, and a powerful energy wave pressed down, slamming everyone to the ground. The next moment, under the effect of Mechanical Force, the metal ground suddenly turned into ropes made of nanoparticles, tying Flying Free and the others up tightly.

Before the various guests could react, the crisis was neutralized by Han Xiao, who was already prepared.

"Phew, fortunately, I was prepared."

Han Xiao heaved a sigh of relief.

The current strength of the players was not even at the Calamity Grade, and they were not much different from ordinary people in front of him. They could not threaten him with numbers alone, but if they attacked others, they would definitely be able to hurt ordinary spectators.

Even if he could react quickly, it would be difficult to guarantee that there would not be any casualties. However, he had already taken down all the players as soon as they attacked, and none of the guests were injured. The short process was frightening but not dangerous, and they could not cause any trouble under his control.

This operation was triggered by Flying Free leading the tempo. With so many people involved, they were no different from a mob. Furthermore, most of the participants acted on impulse — this was the normal behavior of the players. Furthermore, time was tight, and there was not much coordination, so it was impossible to expect them to come up with a detailed plan step by step.

The entire operation itself gave off a feeling of a broken cauldron sinking ships.

"His reaction is too fast!" Winter Wolf only felt his vision blur, and he was caught. He could not fight back at all and was shocked.

He turned his head with difficulty and saw that all his friends were caught by the mechanical soldiers and stuffed into the Restrainers' stomachs, unable to move.

"Damn it, not a single one of them died … But luckily, with us as an example, it's enough to infuriate the army and reduce their trust in all the players under them. This will lower the treatment the army players receive in this faction …"

Winter Wolf felt that it was a pity that the surprise attack had failed, and the effect was greatly reduced. However, judging from the strategic goal, the operation did not completely fail.

These changes happened too fast, and the danger was resolved even faster. The guests and the audience of the various Star Zones were stunned for a long time before they gradually came back to their senses.

Wait a minute, did we just drift on the edge of death?

"What happened just now?"

"It seems like the Black Star Corps betrayed us?"

"They said that Black Star is not Black Star. Why didn't I understand?"

"That scared me. Is this a show?"

After recovering from the shock, the guests present were in an uproar. Because everything happened too quickly, they did not feel any danger at all. They were not afraid at all and only felt surprised.

Everyone was talking at once, but their gazes were all on Han Xiao, who was on the stage. They were all bewildered.

The many army officers immediately gathered around Han Xiao and made a defensive posture, scanning this group of players with extremely unfriendly gazes.

Hila stepped forward with a murderous look on her face. "Take these traitors away and interrogate them. I want to know who ordered them to do this!"

"Sigh, don't be so nervous. I still have some questions to ask them. Plus, I think the guests need an explanation too."

Han Xiao raised his hand in front of Hella and signaled for the soldiers to step back.

Feeling the puzzled and curious gazes of the audience, he calmly raised his finger. The nanoparticles instantly left the metal ground and dragged Flying Free and the others into the air, slowly floating in front of him.

Deliberately showing a confused expression, Han Xiao asked curiously, "What did you say just now?

"What do you mean by that? Why do you think I'm the Mechanic Emperor in disguise?"

Flying Free was a little depressed. The sudden movement of so many people did not even cause a ripple. In the blink of an eye, they were all wiped out and became prisoners of the "Mecha Empire".

But at least he had shouted out to the entire universe, and his goal had been achieved. All that was left in his heart was a sense of heroic self-sacrifice, and he scolded loudly.

"Mecha Empire! No matter how well you pretend, I know you're not the real one! "

"Do you have any evidence?" Han Xiao raised his eyebrows.

Only players could see the screenshots of the character summon card. This evidence was useless to NPCs. Plus, they had already used the character summon card to prove their identity. This reason was naturally not persuasive.

Flying Free had long guessed that he would face this problem. He also knew that he could not convince people other than players. He was already prepared to scold them. Without hesitation, he angered the "Mecha Empire" and said loudly.

"It's the aura!"

"What?" Han Xiao was stunned.

"Humph, our Black Star Army Commander is such a great and righteous person. He has the people of the universe in his heart. Just looking at him is enough to make people admire him. However, you, Mechanic Emperor, disregarded the safety of the universe for your own selfish desires and actually wanted to take the source of the Intelligent Plague for yourself. Your wretched temperament has exposed you!"

"The Mecha Empire is wretched?" Han Xiao raised his tone, deliberately bringing a hint of threat.

"That's quite wretched!" Flying Free was not afraid. "What kind of person is Black Star? In just a few decades, he's already on par with you. An Ancient One? I think you've wasted all your years. You and our Army Commander are completely … F! F! "

Many Beyond Grade As touched their noses awkwardly … Why do I feel like I've been scolded as well?

Han Xiao's face twitched. He tried his best not to laugh.

Wonderful!

This is the feeling. Iron Zi, keep scolding me!

"So … this is the reason for your betrayal?"

"It's not a betrayal! Don't even think about distorting our motives! We've contributed to the army and shed blood for the army. We've long been inseparable from the army. Only Black Star has the right to lead us forward. Any outsider who tries to touch the army will definitely be met with our retaliation! Even if you kill me today, I'll shout from my coffin that I'll never compromise! "

Flying Free spoke so righteously that even Han Xiao was almost touched.

The words that were full of influence made the blood of many hardcore players who were captured alive boil. The emotions that had accumulated over many versions surged into their hearts. They were fearless (they were not afraid of death anyway) and shouted loudly.

"This is the Black Star Corps! Mecha Empire, get out! "

"May Black Star rise as usual!"

"The Army Commander is awesome!"

"The immortals swear not to be slaves!"

The shouts broke through the clouds and reverberated in the field. The heroism and faith contained in them moved many of the audience.

We're good citizens who know our place and have never seen the world. So, this is the daily life of a warlord organization. Love, love.

However, the faces of the Beyond Grade As present all twitched. They were dumbfounded the entire time.

In their understanding, this kind of situation was simply absurd to the point of being unreasonable.

This time, Kant suddenly said, "Actually, I can understand the thoughts of these immortals …"

The group of people turned to look at him, as if 'when did you get sick' was written on their faces.

Kant coughed. "Actually, I've also recruited some immortals. Most of the time, they're quite normal, but occasionally, they'll have mental disorders and do things that I can't understand at all …"

"For example?"

"… Someone asked me to turn into a naked female human in front of me. I accidentally killed him … three times."

Kasuyi agreed. "I also have immortals under my command. Even I can't understand how their minds work. Someone actually wanted to steal my underwear. Can you believe it?"

"I seem to have heard of a theory. Some experts said that the immortality of the immortals caused their minds to undergo synchronized mutation, resulting in intermittent mania, paranoia, logic disorders, tripolar disorder, and other mental disorders."

"Oh, that makes sense …"

Just because his temperament was not right, they suspected that their boss was fake? Which normal person would do such a thing!

However, if it was an immortal who did such a thing, everyone instantly accepted this fact … No matter what the immortals did, it did not seem strange.

As soon as the topic was opened, many of the Beyond Grade As who had recruited players immediately complained. Very soon, they happily reached a consensus that there was something wrong with the immortals' brains. They really admired Black Star for being able to manage the immortals so well.

This time, Secret Master coldly snorted. "What are you all talking about? This is clearly a show directed and acted out by Black Star, deliberately smearing the name of the Mecha Empire. My eyes have long seen through everything."

"It's a pity that the Mecha Empire is not here. Otherwise, his expression would definitely be very interesting." The old dragon chuckled.

Everyone imagined the scene in their minds, and one after another, they let out strange gloating laughter.

Just as the group of people were chatting happily, Han Xiao and Flying Free had already had a few rounds of conversations. One was the main character, the other was the supporting character, and the other was the main character. They changed their ways to smear the name of the Mecha Empire from head to toe again and again.

"Come on, kill me." Fly Free looked like he was ready to die a martyr's death.

Seeing that the situation was about to end, Han Xiao said, "Although you inexplicably believe that I'm the Mecha Empire in disguise, you've indeed misunderstood. How could the Mecha Empire have the ability to impersonate me? His ability is far from it."

Hearing this, Kant could not help but laugh. "Whether he's Black Star or not, do you think we don't know? You guys are still too young, and your actions are too hasty. At least find concrete evidence before acting. "

We do have evidence … but it's a pity that only we can see it.

Seeing the reactions of Han Xiao and the other Beyond Grade As, Flying Free and the others were also a little shaken. There were even more people who did not really believe in the swapping theory, and hearing this, they agreed even more.

The effects of a Character Summon Card could not be faked, so the possibility of the other main direction of speculation was even higher, which was that Black Star had somehow learned the abilities of the Mecha Empire.

Seeing that everyone was hesitating, Han Xiao waved his hand and said, "Take them away first. After the closing ceremony is over, I'll have a good chat with them."

He did not do anything to them on the spot. Dealing with this group of people was the army's internal affairs, and there was no need to show it in such an occasion. He still had to settle this score properly.

The Restrainers escorted all the players who were causing trouble out of the venue. After Sylvia came up to calm everyone down, the Blackstar Cup closing ceremony continued. However, many people's attention was no longer on the ceremony. They were all thinking about this small incident.

Originally, the closing ceremony was just a regular segment, but now, it immediately became a topic of discussion. Han Xiao's goal of using Flying Free and the others had been achieved.

There were no more twists and turns in the closing ceremony. Everything that happened here was also broadcasted to the entire universe by the news media.

Flying Free's performance led to the birth of a new saying in the galaxy — 'Pointing at Black Star and scolding the Mecha Empire'.

What it meant was probably pointing at the mulberry tree and scolding the locust tree.

…

After the live broadcast ended, the black screen reflected Manison's expressionless face.

His eyes narrowed, and a cold light mixed with annoyance flashed through them.

What mistake? Like hell I'll believe you! This was clearly a self-directed and self-acting show!

He did not invite me with good intentions. He just wanted to embarrass me on the spot.

Manison clenched his fists tightly.

Black Star, you little brat, you've gone too far!

Sooner or later, I'll chop you up and turn you into a Felon!
